<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that breaks a t-butyldimethylsilyl group and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl. Using the available functional groups list, we can search the template catalog with functional_groups_broken=['t-butyldimethylsilyl'] and functional_groups_formed=['aliphatic hydroxyls'] to obtain the appropriate template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
